name: usage-meter
description: Live token usage, limits and spend for Claude Code, with warnings before you hit a limit or budget. Works on subscriptions, API keys and cloud providers.

sessionBudgetUsd.title: Session budget (USD)
sessionBudgetUsd.description: Warn as one session's estimated cost nears this. 0 turns it off.

dailyBudgetUsd.title: Daily budget (USD)
dailyBudgetUsd.description: Warn as today's estimated cost across all sessions nears this. 0 turns it off.

limitWarnPercent.title: First warning (%)
limitWarnPercent.description: First warning for usage limits and budgets.

limitAlertPercent.title: Second warning (%)
limitAlertPercent.description: Second warning for usage limits and budgets.

contextWarnPercent.title: Context warning (%)
contextWarnPercent.description: Warn when the context window is this full.

heavyTurnTokens.title: Heavy turn (tokens)
heavyTurnTokens.description: Flag a turn that uses at least this many tokens. 0 turns it off.

heavyTurnUsd.title: Heavy turn (USD)
heavyTurnUsd.description: Flag a turn whose estimated cost is at least this. 0 turns it off.
